shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical surface
framed field bounded by horizontal bands/registers
repeated small rounded motifs (discs/circles or rosettes) in a row
justification: Both are shallow relief panels with a bounded field and a repeated row of small rounded motifs (circular cartouche-like elements in A, rosettes in border bands in B), which is a very generic correspondence. Otherwise the content differs entirely: A shows dense blocky abstract/glyphic units filling the field, while B shows a naturalistic profile scene of a humped animal led by a striding human figure between decorated borders.
